## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the exclusion default so CI can omit matching files through `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that matches file basenames before adding them to the archive. It documents the flag and adds parser, file collection, and archive tests.

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE='*.log'` and no `--exclude` argument, the parser defaults to `[]` and archives `debug.log`. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` requires that “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that set exclusions through the environment include files they intended to omit from their archives.
